title: Comparison of preoperative information media and their influence on the anxiety level of 4 to 11 year old children and their caregivers
summary:
In this study, different preoperative education methods and their influence on the anxiety level of children and their guardians before an operation will be investigated. In order to reduce the anxiety level, the subjects will be assigned to either 4 intervention groups (guided tour, film, book, audio book) or to the control group. In the interventions, the daily routine of an operation day is explained. 
Momentary anxiety is recorded at four different time points. In addition, the children are divided into 2 age groups (4-7 and 7-11 year olds). 
The anxiety level of the interventions will be compared to the control group. In addition, the anxiety level during the course of the intervention will be examined.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Uncomplicated planned operation, understanding of the German language
Exclusion criteria:
Pre-existing conditions with more than 2 inpatient hospitalisations in the past, serious complications during surgery.
Pre-diagnosed anxiety disorders
